mod.help: Settings for the Journey HUD mod.

target_page.title: Target panel
target_page.help: The health, posture and status buildup of the enemy you are locked on to, and where they sit.

minimap_page.title: Minimap
minimap_page.help: The round minimap: what it shows, how big it is and when it hides.

enabled.label: Target bar
enabled.help: Show the health and posture of the enemy you are locked on to.

numbers.label: Health numbers
numbers.help: Show the health, posture and buildup numbers.

effects.label: Target effects
effects.help: Show the effects on the target (poison, rot, frost, sleep...) with the time left.

weak_damage.label: Weak to damage
weak_damage.help: Show which of magic, fire, lightning and holy the target is weak to (green arrows) or resists (red arrows).

weak_effects.label: Weak to effects
weak_effects.help: Show the statuses that build up fastest on the target; the ones it is immune to are faded.

damage_numbers.label: Damage numbers
damage_numbers.help: Float your hits above enemies, colored by damage type.

damage_style.label: Damage number style
damage_style.help: Gradient: one number, the colors of its types stacked. Split: a number per type, flying out one by one.

damage_page.title: Damage numbers
damage_page.help: The numbers floating above enemies: what they show, how they look and their colors.

damage_effects.label: Effect damage
damage_effects.help: Also show damage that is not from your hits: poison, scarlet rot, bleed and frost bursts, burns and other effects.

damage_combo.label: Merge quick hits
damage_combo.help: Hits in quick succession grow one number, with a counter of the hits.

damage_font_size.label: Number size
damage_font_size.help: Size of a plain hit at 1080p. Critical hits and bursts are twice that.

damage_scale.label: Number scale
damage_scale.help: Size multiplier of all damage numbers.

damage_duration.label: Number duration
damage_duration.help: Seconds a number stays on screen.

damage_colors_page.title: Number colors
damage_colors_page.help: The color of each kind of damage number.

damage_colors.help: Pick the color of this kind of damage number.

player_offset_x.label: Buildup gauge shift right
player_offset_x.help: Moves your own buildup gauge to the right, from its place under the status icons.

player_offset_y.label: Buildup gauge shift down
player_offset_y.help: Moves your own buildup gauge down.

target_offset_x.label: Target bar right margin
target_offset_x.help: Distance of the target bar from the right edge. 0 keeps it under the minimap.

target_offset_y.label: Target bar top margin
target_offset_y.help: Distance from the top edge. Once moved, the bar stops following the minimap.

rune_offset_x.label: Rune counter right margin
rune_offset_x.help: Distance of the moved rune counter from the right edge.

rune_offset_y.label: Rune counter top margin
rune_offset_y.help: Distance of the moved rune counter from the top edge.

keys_page.title: Hotkeys
keys_page.help: Type a key name such as F6, J or 0x75 (a virtual-key code).

reload_key.label: Reload config key
reload_key.help: Reloads JourneyHUD.toml without restarting the game.

toggle_key.label: Hide and show key
toggle_key.help: Hides and shows the minimap and the target panel. Empty means no key.

drag_key.label: Move layout key
drag_key.help: Lets you drag the minimap and the target bar with the mouse. Empty means no key.

effects_player.label: Your effects
effects_player.help: Show the time left of your own effects under the game's status icons.

timer_style.label: Shared icon timers
timer_style.help: Which times to show under an icon that several of your effects share.

player_buildup.label: Your status buildup
player_buildup.help: Move your own buildup gauge (poison, rot...) to the top left, under the status icons.

player_scale.label: Buildup gauge size
player_scale.help: Size of your own buildup gauge (poison, rot...) at the top left. 1 = the game's own size.

boss_bar.label: Boss bars
boss_bar.help: Move the game's boss bars down and add the boss's posture and effects under them. Needs a restart.

enemy_hp_bar.label: Enemy health bars
enemy_hp_bar.help: Show the health bars the game floats above ordinary enemies; off hides them and their damage numbers. Needs a restart.

enemy_damage.label: Enemy damage numbers
enemy_damage.help: Show the damage numbers the game floats above ordinary enemies; off hides them (the mod's own are in Damage numbers). Needs a restart.

rune_counter.label: Rune counter at the top right
rune_counter.help: Move the game's rune counter to the top right. Drag it with the drag key.

rune_counter_scale.label: Rune counter size
rune_counter_scale.help: Size of the moved rune counter. 1 = the game's own.

buildup.label: Status buildup
buildup.help: Show the poison, rot, bleed, death blight, frost, sleep and madness buildup of the target.

scale.label: Size
scale.help: Size of the target bar. 1 = normal.

offset_x.label: Right margin
offset_x.help: Distance from the right edge. Negative values move the minimap and target bar right.

offset_y.label: Top margin
offset_y.help: Distance of the minimap (or the target bar, without it) from the top edge of the screen.

minimap.label: Minimap
minimap.help: Show a round minimap with the other players, your spirits and the enemy you are locked on to.

minimap_map.label: Map
minimap_map.help: Draw the game's world map under the minimap. Needs the game's map files, which it reads from the game folder.

minimap_graces.label: Graces
minimap_graces.help: Mark the sites of grace you have found on the minimap.

minimap_points.label: Points of interest
minimap_points.help: Mark the ruins, churches, caves, bosses and other places of the world map on the minimap.

minimap_beacons.label: Beacons
minimap_beacons.help: Mark the beacons you have placed on the world map on the minimap.

minimap_goblins.label: Map for Goblins
minimap_goblins.help: Mark the items and places of the Map for Goblins DLL on the minimap, when it is installed.

minimap_coop.label: Co-op players
minimap_coop.help: Mark your co-op partners on the minimap.

minimap_spirits.label: Spirits
minimap_spirits.help: Mark your summoned spirits on the minimap.

minimap_enemies.label: Enemies
minimap_enemies.help: Mark the hostile enemies near you as red dots on the minimap.

minimap_full_map.label: Full map
minimap_full_map.help: Show the whole world map. Off shows only what your map fragments reveal.

minimap_clock.label: Clock
minimap_clock.help: Show the in-game time under the minimap.

minimap_deaths.label: Deaths
minimap_deaths.help: Show your death count above the minimap.

minimap_trail.label: Trail
minimap_trail.help: Draw the path you have walked on the minimap.

minimap_compass.label: Compass
minimap_compass.help: Show N, E, S and W on the rim of the minimap.

minimap_rotate.label: Turn with camera
minimap_rotate.help: Turn the minimap with the camera. Off keeps north at the top.

minimap_hide_roundtable.label: Hide at Roundtable
minimap_hide_roundtable.help: Hide the minimap in Roundtable Hold.

minimap_hide_caves.label: Hide in caves
minimap_hide_caves.help: Hide the minimap in caves, catacombs and tunnels.

minimap_hide_boss.label: Hide in boss fights
minimap_hide_boss.help: Hide the minimap while a boss health bar is on screen.

minimap_range.label: Minimap range
minimap_range.help: How far the minimap sees, from its center to its rim, in meters.
